content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.created_at, p.status, o.id as order_exists, o.status as order_status FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 'captured' AND o.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT 10", "why": "Check if captured payments have missing orders and when these payments were created to correlate with deploy timing"}], "hypotheses": [], "summary": "Investigating missing orders for captured payments to determine if deploy caused order lookup failures"}
